title: Understanding Visualizations
text: Consider what types of visualizations are typically used to represent numerical data like price.

title: Common Visualizations for Numerical Data
text: Think about histograms, box plots, and scatter plots. Which of these are suitable for visualizing a single numerical variable like price?

title: Histogram Explanation
text: A histogram is a type of bar chart that represents the distribution of numerical data. Is this suitable for visualizing the price?

title: Box Plot Explanation
text: A box plot shows the distribution of data based on a five-number summary. Can this be used to visualize the price?
